description: Regression conversations for the audit findings (docs/AUDIT-SIE-9-LAYERS-2026-10.md). Each states the CORRECT behaviour. A run is red while its defect exists and must fail exactly on the expectations in failingNow; the work package that fixes the defect flips it to green. All conversations are synthetic.

conversations.title: "Yes, I have a problem with payment" at the ticket question is not a decline
Restating the problem at the ticket question is diagnosed, not taken as a decline
conversations.partlyFixedIn: WP3: the restated problem is no longer read as a decline (no review is queued). Still red for WP4: at the pending ticket question the bridge re-asks instead of diagnosing it.

conversations.title: A plain Arabic "no" (لا) at the ticket question declines it
A plain Egyptian "yes" (اه) at the ticket question opens exactly one ticket
An unclear answer re-asks at most once; the conversation is not held at the ticket question
"I tried the steps but it didn't work" after an answer does not close the conversation or wipe its state
A negated "it worked" is never acknowledged as satisfaction
"That worked, but I have another problem with payment" after an answer is diagnosed, not closed

turns.say: تمام اشتغلت، بس عندي مشكلة تانية في الدفع

conversations.note: Added in WP3. Layer 1 reads this correctly: resolution=resolved AND diagnosticContent=true (entity_payment, symptom_generic_problem). The route ignores the second signal and closes the conversation, wiping its state. Closing rules move to Decision in WP4 (G-L5-4); that change flips this run.

conversations.title: "How do I install WhatsApp Business" is a how-to, not anger: no escalation, it is diagnosed
Sincere praise with no complaint context does not escalate to a human
"That's enough, thanks" is a polite closing, not anger
A closing remark in one chat does not become a hypothesis in the customer's next chat
A ticket-status question in one chat does not tie with a subscription-status question in the next
"No, nothing else" is never diagnosed as a problem and never offered a ticket

turns.say: مفيش مشكلة، بس عندي سؤال عام عن المنصة

conversations.title: Declining a ticket, then accepting one later, creates exactly one ticket and never claims a ticket that does not exist
A ticket question left unanswered expires; the next day's greeting is a greeting
A customer with an open ticket who asks for its status is told about that ticket
When the customer says the problem is not WhatsApp, WhatsApp is no longer the leading hypothesis

turns.say: لا المشكلة مش في الواتساب، المشكلة في الايميل

conversations.title: A screenshot sent after the engine asked for one reaches the engine as evidence (metadata only)
Every paid turn writes exactly one trace, on every route
Across two chats of one customer, every paid turn on every route writes exactly one trace that records what was sent
The trace records the reply actually sent, not the decision's intended text
When the shadow decides exactly what the live engine decided, the comparison says they agree
"Hi, WhatsApp is down" is diagnosed, not answered as a greeting
"I'm the manager and can't add an employee" is diagnosed and does not store a fragment as the customer's name

turns.say: انا المدير ومش قادر اضيف موظف

conversations.title: Adding a detail after an answer is not, by itself, read as "the solution failed"
No decision rule is unreachable by construction (R6C at Infinity)
A genuine customer listing several real problems at once is diagnosed, not quarantined to zero evidence (trust boundary, outside the nine layers; plan priority P2)

turns.say: السلام عليكم، عندي مشكلة من امبارح الواتساب مش بيبعت رسايل للعملاء والاشتراك مدفوع والفاتورة اتخصمت وكمان الموظفين مش قادرين يدخلوا الحساب والداشبورد مش بيحمل والتذاكر مش بتتفتح والرسايل بتتأخر والـ API بيرجع 429 والويبهوك مش بيوصل

conversations.title: The owner's example: «the problem is solved, but I have another one with payment» closes nothing and diagnoses the payment problem

conversations.title: New problem first, resolution second («I have a payment problem, and the first one got solved»): the answered problem is not re-ticketed

conversations.title: «طيب» after an answer is neither a failure (ticket) nor a resolution (close)
«I did not understand step two» after an answer is not a ticket
A different problem typed at the ticket question supersedes the question and is diagnosed
A problem typed at the escalation's ticket question supersedes it and is diagnosed; nothing is declined or handed off
«مش قادر ادخل على حسابي» restated at the ticket question is the problem again, not a «no»
After a declined ticket, a new problem is pursued — the declined ticket is not proposed again
Once a ticket really exists, restating the problem says it is open — it is never proposed a second time
A ticket question records `proposed`, never `created`
A ticket the trust boundary withholds records `withheld`; a later accepted ticket is created exactly once

العميل: مش قادر ادخل على حسابي

conversations.title: With tickets switched off, a ticket decision records `unavailable`
An open ticket on the account records `existing` — not `created`
An hour after the escalation's ticket question, a new problem is diagnosed; the old question is not revived
An hour after a diagnostic ticket question, a new problem is diagnosed; the old question is not revived
A clear «yes» an hour after the ticket question still opens exactly one ticket (an expired question is not an invalid answer)
A clear «yes» an hour after the escalation's ticket question opens the ticket and hands off
A clear «no» an hour after the ticket question is a valid decline
An unrelated message an hour after the ticket question is answered on its own; the question is dropped, not re-asked
Anger with a concrete problem and no prior context: the problem is diagnosed and acknowledged, not handed off

conversations.title: Kill switch off: sarcasm escalates on the phrase alone, as before WP4
A ticket question asked in one chat does not capture a «yes» typed in another chat of the same customer; the original chat still honours its own answer
Anger or praise said about oneself («انا متعصب جدا», «انا مبسوط جدا بصراحة») is neither escalated nor stored as the customer's name
conversations.note: Found in WP4's production-profile verification: once anger and praise without context stopped escalating (owner decision D3), the memory reading took these as self-introductions. Fixed in Layer 1 (memory-intent NOT_A_NAME).

conversations.title: With the account's own open ticket on file, restating the problem names that ticket — it does not claim «the ticket we opened»
conversations.note: Found in WP4's production-profile verification (probe P7).

conversations.title: An ambiguous first message is clarified, not ticketed: no ticket on ambiguity before one clarifying attempt
«لا مفيش حاجة تانية» after a question is a closing remark: answered as one, never diagnosed or ticketed

turns.say: مفيش مشكلة، بس عندي سؤال عام عن المنصة

conversations.title: A problem whose last evidence is older than the context window does not colour a new problem, even when small talk kept the chat alive
"That worked" closes the episode explicitly: the next problem starts from an empty episode and the closed one is summarised, not silently wiped
